summary: CQC data pipeline is production-grade with documented reconciliation process. The README describes: immutable snapshot → deterministic shards → finalized before watermark advance. Reconciliation must pass count, coverage, checksum, and watermark gates. Quality audit (quality_report.json) confirms 55,818 providers with per-field completeness. The pipeline has explicit freshness monitoring: 15-minute watchdog records deduplicated state in Postgres, /api/v1/health/freshness, /data-status public endpoint, and /api/health/directory for frontend mode. The codebase includes extract_cqc.py, clean_cqc.py, prepare_directory.py, quality_audit.py, incremental_update.py.
assertions: CQC reconciliation: immutable snapshot → deterministic shards → watermark advance with count/coverage/checksum gates
Freshness watchdog: 15-minute interval, deduplicated Postgres state, ops@caregist.co.uk notifications
Public freshness at /data-status (verified live at https://www.caregist.co.uk/data-status)
API health: /api/v1/health/liveness, /readiness, /freshness; /api/v1/version returns deployed Git SHA
Quality report: quality_report.json with per-field completeness, 0 invalid postcodes
